scope: Independent source review and one supplied-data reader test run.

tests.fixtures: Literal algebraic arrays only; no simulated observations.

checks: The search marker is exactly rederived with complete_search before endpoint measurement, without a new identity or backend call.
All32 final ordered genotype bytes and native IDs bind checkpoint, public population, final selection record and a new pinned endpoint_population snapshot.
Three standalone references bind protocol/input pins, manifest order, float32 raw array and decoded genome bytes.
The worker uses existing LifeEvaluator.run Cartesian genotype-major batching; each returned raw ledger/hash array is saved before accounting/status checks.
Endpoint panel and confirmation use disjoint fixed32 and512 seed lists; each genotype sees the same per-world panel.
Endpoint rule maximizes min of three capture means divided by fixed AO scales, then the per-seed0.5patch+0.25POOL+0.25persistent ordinary-F mean, then native ID.
The equal32-per-world endpoint sampling does not substitute an equal-world fitness mean; the supplied-array weighting counterexample passes.
Joint genome and endpoint receipt are written exclusively, rederived from saved endpoint raw/scored data, and pinned in endpoints.json before any confirmation cohort.
Confirmation never selects a genome; all4roles and6worlds retain all512whole lives, ordinary extinction/guard costs and all107 native ledger columns.
Primary depth8_joint-minus-Pareto4_joint and secondary depth8_joint-minus-AO/G8_joint use paired same-seed per-life differences and SE.
Old-world90percent margins and capture ratios are diagnostic, not an admission gate; initial/refill energy remains distinct, including reserved capacity3.
Measurement emits the exact counts and hash bindings verified by analyze; the runner receiver accepts its9cohort schema and requires the completed protocol-bound summary.
Final release/protocol checks and phase-specific ownership paths match the reviewed common/monitor implementation.
limitations: No end-to-end native measurement was run in this source review.
The accounting reducer is unchanged and SHA-pinned; its base physical tests were not repeated.
Life SE and the fresh endpoint ranking do not estimate reliability across evolutionary searches.
